about: Display names for the vendor's act_ nodes (node names are unique across all prop sets). Books also carry title, author, their cover material (book_cover_<n>) and the cover's UV rect [u_min, v_min, u_max, v_max] in glTF texture space (origin top-left, as three.js samples glTF textures) in prop_tex_books_color.webp.
